steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Gate. Each objective needs a measure, each alternative a value, and each walk-away point a basis.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Objective with no measure
findings.fix: Set the measure before the meeting

findings.title: Walk-away point with no basis
findings.fix: Give the basis from the alternative's value

findings.title: Alternative with no value
findings.fix: Put a value on the alternative

outcome.notChecked: The other party's position; the legal effect of any term.

pros: Checks an objective with no measure, an alternative with no value, and a walk-away point with no basis.
cons: Not checked: The other party's position; the legal effect of any term.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-hr-negotiation-brief skill on the records for this review.
